title: Conditionals Type 1 and 2 / Kondisyonel yi 1 ak 2
bridge: Bëppat bi, ci suñu yoon wi, dëgg ci subjunctif ci suufuwaay bi ci suñu yoon wi, ak ci kondisyonel simple ci suufuwaay bi ci suñu yoon wi (Si teel naa, laajuma). Ci ingleer, laa wax ci bu ñu ko waxal: ci kondisyonel yu bees, dëgg ci present simple ci suufuwaay bi 'if', ak ci futur ak 'will' ci suufuwaay bi ci suñu yoon wi. Ci kondisyonel yu ñett, dëgg ci passé simple ci suufuwaay bi 'if', ak 'would' + infinitif ci suufuwaay bi ci suñu yoon wi. Dafa dox ci yoon wi: ci ingleer, passé simple ci kondisyonel yu ñett, du taxawal waxtaan wi, waaye yoon wi yu jëmm ak yoon wi yu amul jëmm ci suñu yoon wi. Dafa dox ci yoon wi: dara laa wax ci suñu yoon wi ci ingleer, waaye laa waxal ci bu ñu ko waxal, ndax laa wax ci bu ñu ko waxal, ndax laa wax ci bu ñu ko waxal, ndax laa wax ci bu ñu ko waxal.
rule: Kondisyonel yu bees (yoon wi 1) laa wax ci jëmm ak yoon wi yu amul jëmm ci suñu yoon wi ak suñu yoon wi. Laa wax ci: If + sujet + verbe ci present simple, + sujet + will + verbe base. Jëfandikoo: If it rains, we will stay at home. Suufuwaay bi 'if' laa wax ci suñu yoon wi ak suñu yoon wi, ak ci suñu yoon wi ak suñu yoon wi. Dara laa wax ci 'unless' (teel naa) ci suñu yoon wi ci 'if not'. Kondisyonel yu ñett (yoon wi 2) laa wax ci jëmm ak yoon wi yu amul jëmm ci suñu yoon wi ak suñu yoon wi. Laa wax ci: If + sujet + verbe ci passé simple, + sujet + would + verbe base. Jëfandikoo: If I had more money, I would travel. Ci kondisyonel yu ñett, verbe 'to be' laa wax ci 'were' ci suñu yoon wi (If I were...). 'Was' laa wax ci suñu yoon wi ci suñu yoon wi, waaye ci ingleer yu amul jëmm ci suñu yoon wi. Dara laa wax ci 'could' ak 'might' ci suñu yoon wi ak suñu yoon wi ak 'would' ak ci suñu yoon wi ak suñu yoon wi. Kondisyonel yu ñett laa wax ci jëmm ak yoon wi yu amul jëmm ci suñu yoon wi ak suñu yoon wi ak ci suñu yoon wi ak suñu yoon wi.

title: Passive Voice: Present & Past / Faw laaj
bridge: In wuɗu waloo, faw laaj dañu ko wax ci 'ser' + participle, toogal ci ingleer (to be + past participle). Waaye, ci ingleer, ci liggéeykat yi dañu ko wax ci 'by', ci wuɗu waloo, moo ko wax ci 'por'. Bés, ci ingleer, liggéeykat yi ñu ko wax ci 'by' (waaye, moo ko wax ci 'by' laa ko wax ci 'se'). Xammeeku jëkk wi, moo ko wax ci 'to be' wuutee, walla moo ko wax ci participle laaj bu baaxul.
rule: Faw laaj dañu ko wax ci 'to be' ci waxtu toogal (present simple: am/is/are; past simple: was/were) + participle laaj bu baaxul ci liggéeykat bu jënd. Liggéeykat yi ci liggéeykat bu jënd dañu ko wax ci 'by' (waaye, moo ko wax ci 'by' laa ko wax ci liggéeykat bu baaxul). Ci liggéeykat bu jënd, liggéeykat bu jënd dañu ko wax ci liggéeykat bu jënd. Xammeeku: Active: 'The chef cooks the meal' → Passive: 'The meal is cooked by the chef'. Ci present, moo ko wax ci 'is/are' toogal ci liggéeykat (singular/plural). Ci passé, 'was/were'. Participe laaj bu baaxul, moo ko wax ci liggéeykat bu jënd (regular: -ed; irregular: liste). Xammeeku: faw laaj moo ko wax ci liggéeykat bu jënd (no liggéeykat). Xammeeku jëkk wi: liggéeykat bu jënd moo ko wax ci liggéeykat bu jënd, waaye moo ko wax ci liggéeykat bu jënd.

title: Reported Speech / Xeexu bu njëkk
bridge: Àddina si espagnol, ñu ngi junniy waxtu yi (baat baat, 'dijo que tenía hambre'), ak àngale, moom lañuy waxe ngir yeneen yi: ñaari yi (today→that day, here→there) ak xew-xewu, waaye ñu ngi doon defaroonal seeni waxtu wi (dijo: 'I am tired' → *She said she is tired), waaye àngale B1, ñu ngi defaroonal seeni waxtu wi: 'She said she was tired'. Yeneen waxtu, àngale, ñu ngi doon waxtu 'that' ngir waxtu yi (ñu ngi wax 'She said she was tired' walla 'She said that she was tired'), waaye espagnol, 'que' maa ngi wax
rule: Xeexu bu njëkk, moom ngi waxe ngir defaroonal seeni waxtu yi. Àngale, verbe bu njëkk, moom ngi 'say' walla 'tell'. 'Say' maa ngi waxtu ngir ñaari (He said he was happy), waaye 'tell' ngi waxtu ngir ñaari (He told me he was happy). Waxtu yi: 1) Waxtu yi (present→past, past→pluscuamperfecto): 'I am' → 'she was', 'I went' → 'she had gone'. 2) Ñaari yi: 'I' → 'he/she', 'my' → 'his/her'. 3) Adverbial yi: 'today'→'that day', 'tomorrow'→'the next day', 'yesterday'→'the day before'. 4) Lugar: 'here'→'there'. Waxtu yi: si waxtu yi, moom ngi waxe ngir seeni waxtu wi (She said she is tired - si maa ngi waxe), waaye si waxtu yi, moom ngi waxe ngir seeni waxtu wi. Ngir waxtu yi, ñu ngi wax 'if' walla 'whether' ngir waxtu yi, ak waxtu yi ngir waxtu yi, ak waxtu yi ngir waxtu yi, ak waxtu yi ngir waxtu yi.

title: Gerunds and Infinitives as Subject and Object / Gerundioy infinitivos my sujeto ak objekt
bridge: Ci waxu ñu ngi ci farañse, ñu ngi defar infinitivu ngir sujeto ak ñeneen ña ca waxi verb (baat ba, 'nadar mooy ndaw' , 'muy goste nadar'). Ci waxu ñu ngi ci angale, waxu jëkkëreelu: ñu ngi defar gerundiyu (-ing) ak ñu ngi defar infinitivu (to + verb). Lëkkëlëkku bu njëkk, wu ko waxe jëfandikukat bu njëkk, waaye wu ko defar infinitivu ngir ña ca waxi verb yi (baat ba, 'want' 'decide'). Lii mooy waxu jëkkëreelu ngir ñu waxu ñu jàngale, ndax dañu amul benn xeltu.
rule: Ci waxu ñu ngi ci angale, ñu ngi defar nañu wàññi verb yi: gerundiyu (verb + -ing) ak infinitivu (to + bu njëkk). Waaye, ngir sujeto, gerundiyu mooy lëkkëlëkku bu njëkk (baat ba, 'Swimming mooy ndaw'). Ngir ña ca waxi verb yi, defar bu njëkk bu amul (baat ba, enjoy, finish, avoid, suggest, consider), ñeneen ñi defar infinitivu (want, need, decide, hope, plan). Ñu ngi defar verb yi ñu jëfandikukat bu njëkk ngir defar infinitivu (baat ba, 'stop' 'remember'). Ngir ñu jàngale B1, mooy waxu jëkkëreelu defar lëkkëlëkku bu njëkk yi ak ñu defar ña ca waxi verb yi.

title: Modal Verbs for Deduction / Modali yi ci dedukci (must, might, could)
bridge: Ci spañol, ñu ngi ci 'debe de' ci dedukci yi ci probabilité élevée, 'puede que' ci posibilité moyenne, et 'podría' ci chose moins sûre. Par contre, ci anglais, ñu ngi ci différence clé : les modaux ne se conjuguent pas et ne portent pas 'to'. Un autre point important, c'est que ci spañol, on utilise souvent le futur ('será') pour spéculer, mais ci anglais, on utilise 'must' + verbe de base. Cela peut te confondre si tu traduis littéralement. Rapelle-toi : ci anglais, la déduction s'exprime avec le modal + le verbe à la forme de base, sans 'to', et l'ordre de la phrase est sujet + modal + verbe.
rule:
Ci anglais, pour faire des déductions sur le présent, on utilise 'must', 'might' et 'could'. 
- **Must** + verbe de base : indique une déduction avec une certitude élevée (logique, preuve forte). Équivaut à 'debe de' ci spañol. Exemple : 'She must be at home' (Debe de estar en casa). 
- **Might** + verbe de base : indique une possibilité moyenne, incertitude. Équivaut à 'puede que' ou 'quizás'. Exemple : 'He might be sick' (Puede que esté enfermo). 
- **Could** + verbe de base : indique également une possibilité, mais parfois on l'utilise pour suggérer que quelque chose est possible, mais pas très probable. Équivaut à 'podría'. Exemple : 'It could rain today' (Podría llover hoy). 

**Formes:** les modaux ne changent pas avec la personne (on n'ajoute pas '-s' avec he/she/it). Ils ne portent pas 'to' après eux. La négation de 'must' pour déduction est 'can't' (non 'mustn't') : 'She can't be at work' (No puede estar en el trabajo). 

**Utilisation:** on les utilise pour parler de déductions logiques au présent. Pour les déductions au passé, on utilise 'must have + participe', 'might have + participe', etc., mais cela est plus avancé pour B1. 

**Exceptions:** on n'utilise pas 'must' pour des questions de déduction ; à la place, on utilise 'Do you think...' ou la structure interrogative avec 'be' ou d'autres verbes.

title: Relative Clauses: Defining vs. Non-Defining / Jëfandikukat: wuññi yi ñu jëfandikoo
bridge: Àddina, jëfandikukat wuññi yi ñu jëfandikoo ñoom ñi ngi bokk ci njabootam ak benn xar: ñooy jëfandikoo ñi bokk ci xar. Ànglè, buñu benn xar, taxawal bu jëfandikoo gi ñu sol: 'that' ñi ngi jëfandikoo ci wuññi yi, waaye 'which/who' ci jëfandikoo ñi bokk ci xar ñi ngi jëfandikoo ci benn xar. Maa ngi dégg: ànglè, ñu ngi tàmbali 'that' ci jëfandikoo ñi bokk ci xar.
rule: Jëfandikukat wuññi yi (ñi ngi jëfandikoo ci moomu ñaata lañu wër) ñoom ñi bokk ci benn xar, waaye ñu ngi tàmbali 'that' 'who/which'. Ànd ak ñaata lool, 'that' (ak jëfandikoo gi ñu sol) ñu ngi tàmbali: 'The book (that) I bought'. Jëfandikukat ñi bokk ci xar (ñi ngi jëfandikoo ci mboolem) ñi ngi jëfandikoo ci benn xar, waaye ñu ngi tàmbali 'who' ci ñaata lool, 'which' ci yëngu-yëngu, waaye dàkku 'that'. Jëfandikoo ñi ngi tàmbali ci jëfandikukat ñi bokk ci xar. Misaal: Defining: 'The woman who lives next door is a doctor.' (Jigéen ji ñu nekk ci ndaw ndaw la, mooy doktoor). Non-defining: 'My sister, who lives in Madrid, is a doctor.' (Sama sëriñ, ji ñu nekk ci Madrid, mooy doktoor).

title: Wish + past / Wish to express unreal desires
bridge: Ci làkk ñu xamal español, ñu xamal 'ojalá' o 'me gustaría que' ak subjunctive ñaar ñi ñu jox deseos ñi ñu bëgg. Ci làkk Anglè, 'wish' def ñu bëgg ak temps passé (simple o perfect) ñi ñu joxe ñu bëgg ci làkk ñu bëgg ñaata la woon, walla ñu bëgg ñaata def lu tol. Bégg bu njëkk bu njëkk ñi ñu xew-xew, mooy ñu xew-xew présent o conditionnel ('I wish I have...' o 'I wish I would have...'), ñu xew-xew ñi làkk español. Yàlla: passé ci Anglè, def moom la ñu joxe ñu bëgg, dina ñu bëgg.
rule: Mbooloom gu bawoo woon na: **wish + sujet + verbe passé simple** ñi ñu jox deseos ñu bëgg ci làkk présent (situations ñi ñu bëgg ñaata la woon, hipotétiques). Baat baat, 'I wish I knew the answer' (Maa ngi ñi dégg). Ñu joxe deseos ñu bëgg ci làkk passé (lu ñu bëgg ñaata def lu tol), ñu xamal **wish + passé perfect** ('I wish I had studied more'). Ñu bëgg 'would' ci làkk 'wish' ñaar ñu bëgg sujet ñu ngi def (I wish I would... ñu bëgg). Ñu xamal 'would' ñaar ñu bëgg ñu joxe deseos ñu bëgg ci làkk ñu bëgg ñepp. Ci làkk 'wish' + 'were' def ñu bëgg, ñu xamal 'was' ñaar ñu bëgg (ñu bëgg ñu xew-xew Anglè informal). Yàlla: 'wish' def ñu joxe arrepentimiento o frustration; ñu xamal 'hope' (I hope you come) ñi ñu jox deseos ñu bëgg.

title: Used to / Defi hábitu ya
bridge: Ŋi àddiya, ñu ngi def ko 'solía + infinitivo' walla it ñu ngi def ko pretérito imperfecto ('jugaba') defi hábitu ya. Ŋi angiis, 'used to' moom defi làkk benn, te def ko bu njëkk, te def ko bu ñaata (I used to, she used to). Jëf ju nekk di def ko bu dégg, mooy def ko 'used to' ak 'be used to' (àddiya ngone) walla 'use to' defi négatif ak wàkku. Def ko bu njëkk, ñu ngi def ko 'didn't use to' ak 'Did you use to?'
rule: Used to def ko defi hábitu walla defi màgg ya, te def ko bu njëkk. Def ko bu njëkk mooy: sujeto + used to + verbo base. Def ko bu njëkk, def ko bu màgg, bu njëkk bu def ko bu baax; bu baax, ñu ngi def ko 'usually' + présent simple. Defi négatif, def ko bu njëkk mooy: didn't use to + verbo base. Defi wàkku, def ko bu njëkk mooy: Did + sujeto + use to + verbo base? (bu dégg -d). Def ko bu njëkk, ñu ngi def ko bu dégg 'I use to' defi hábitu ya, walla 'used to' bu njëkk dégg -ed defi hábitu ya, te def ko bu njëkk. Def ko bu njëkk, 'would' def ko defi hábitu ya, walla bu njëkk bu def ko bu màgg, te def ko bu njëkk.

title: Purpose, Cause and Result / Wutal, Mbalit ak Xel
bridge: Ci waxoon waxe di waxe 'para que' wutal ak 'porque' mbalit, waaye ci angale 'so that' ak 'because (of)' waxe di waxe. Tekki wu nekkoon wi nekkoon 'so that' dees di ko defar claus (sujet + verbe), waaye 'because of' dees di ko defar nom.
rule:
Wutal, mbalit ak xel ci angale, waxe di waxe yeneen yooye:
- **Wutal:** 'so that' (wutal) + clausa ak verbe modal (can, could, will, would) walla présent simple. Misaal: 'I study so that I can pass the exam.' Dees ko waxe 'in order to' (wutal) + infinitif, waaye dees ko waxe formal.
- **Mbalit:** 'because' (mbalit) + clausa, walla 'because of' (mbalite) + nom walla sintagm nominal. Misaal: 'She stayed home because she was sick' (clausa) vs. 'She stayed home because of the rain' (nom).
- **Xel:** 'so' (xel) + clausa xel. Misaal: 'It was raining, so we stayed home.' Dees ko waxe 'therefore' (xel) ci kontekst formal.

title: Common Phrasal Verbs / Verbos Frasales Más Comunes
bridge: Wolof, ñu bari verbe ñi ngi def ko ci jamono (baat ba, dem), waaye angale, phrasal verbs yi ci mel ni verbe ak partikul (up, down, off, bari), ñi ngi def ko ci jamono. Baat ba, 'get up' moom lañu ko 'gëstu araf', waaye 'suul'. Suufe yi ngi bari ci ñaata ay partikul yi, waaye ñoom ñi ngi def ko ci jamono, te ñu bari ñoom ngir ñaata lépp, te ñu bari ñoom ngir ñaata ay verbe.
rule: Phrasal verb moom verbe ak partikul (prepozisyon, adverbe), ñi ngi def ko ci jamono. Jamono ji verbe ak partikul yi, bari nañu ko def ngir ñaata ay verbe ak partikul yi. Ñu bari ñoom ngir ñaata lépp: transitif ak intransitif. Transitif yi bari nañu ko def ngir ñaata lépp: separabel ak inseparabel. Separabel yi, obje (nom, pronon) bari nañu ko def ngir ñaata ay verbe ak partikul, waaye ñu pronon (it, them, bari) bari nañu ko def ngir ñaata ay verbe ak partikul: 'turn it off' (dalla 'turn off it'). Inseparabel yi, obje bari nañu ko def ngir ñaata ay partikul: 'look after the children' (dalla 'look children after'). Phrasal verb bari nañu ko def ngir ñaata lépp, waaye ñu bari ñoom ngir ñaata ay obje: 'wake up', 'grow up'. Bari nañu ko def ngir ñaata ay jamono, te bari nañu ko def ngir ñaata ay verbe. Ngir nataal B1, phrasal verb yi bari nañu ko def ngir ñaata lépp: get up, wake up, turn on/off, put on, take off, look for, look after, find out, give up, go on, come back, bari.

title: Advanced Quantifiers / Kuñuñu yoon wi
bridge: Ñu ngi ci Spanyol, ñu def ngi 'yàpp', 'beneen', 'kuñuñu' ñeel tàggat, waaye ñi ngi ci Angale, yoon wi yépp te rew mi ngi ci anam gu yàgg gañe gu mag ci wàll, gu yàgg gañe gu jëfandikoo ak gu yàgg gañe gu bon. Bari nañu kër, 'hardly any' ak 'plenty of' dëggele nanu xool, 'hardly any' jëfandikoo ci 'kuñuñu' ak 'yàpp', waaye 'plenty of' def ko 'beneen', dëgge nanu ko 'yàpp'. Ginnaaw, tàmbali 'plenty of' dafay jëfandikoo ci yëngu ye, dëgge nanu ko ci yëngu yàpp ak wàcc
rule: Kuñuñu yoon wi ci Angale (B1) ngi jëfandikoo: 'hardly any' (kuñuñu/ yàpp) jëfandikoo ci yëngu ye ak yëngu yàpp, ak def ko yàgg gañe gu bon. 'Plenty of' (beneen, beneen) jëfandikoo ci yëngu ye ci yëngu ye ak yëngu yàpp (dëgge nanu ci yëngu yàpp ak wàcc). Yoon wi yépp: 'a good deal of' (beneen, jëfandikoo ci yëngu yàpp), 'a large amount of' (beneen, jëfandikoo ci yëngu yàpp), 'a large number of' (beneen, jëfandikoo ci yëngu ye), 'a couple of' (yàpp, jëfandikoo ci yëngu ye). Tàmbali: 'plenty of' jëfandikoo ci yëngu, dëgge nanu ko ci wàcc. 'Hardly any' jëfandikoo ci yëngu, ak def ko yàgg gañe gu bon. Ci yëngu yàpp ak wàcc, ñu jëfandikoo 'much' ak 'many' dëgge nanu 'plenty'.

title: Verb patterns: verb + infinitive / gerund / Patrones verbals: verbo + infinitivo / gerundio
bridge: Àdaxu ngànnaa, suuf si jëfandikoo verbe bu njëkk bu ñu xam ne (i.e. 'bëgg naa def', 'sàkk naa wax'). Njàngale ko, àdaxu angalte, ñaari verbe yi (bàyyi 'enjoy', 'avoid', 'finish') ñoo ko jëfandikoo gerund (ing), waaye ñaari verbe yi (bàyyi 'want', 'decide', 'hope') ñoo ko jëfandikoo infinitif bu 'to'. Njàngale ko, ñoo ngi verbe yi ñu bàyyi def te bàyyi gerund (tàkk 'stop to smoke' vs. 'stop smoking'). Njàngale ko mën nañu kòwwale àdduna angalte.
rule: Àdaxu angalte, verbe bu njëkk yi jëfandikoo verbe yi ñu xam ne ñaari njari: bu infinitif bu 'to' (I want to go) bu gerund (ing) (I enjoy going). Jëfandikoo mën nañu def te verbe bu njëkk. Lisiti yi ñu jëfandikoo: - Verbe yi ñu jëfandikoo infinitif: want, need, decide, hope, plan, promise, agree, offer, forget, learn, etc. - Verbe yi ñu jëfandikoo gerund: enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, consider, suggest, practice, admit, deny, etc. - Verbe yi ñu jëfandikoo ñaari njari te def te bàyyi: start, begin, continue, like, love, hate, prefer. - Verbe yi ñu bàyyi def te bàyyi: remember, forget, stop, try, regret. (I.e. 'Remember to lock the door' = gis naa def te bàyyi; 'Remember locking the door' = gis naa def te bàyyi). Mbaa: verbe yi ñu jëfandikoo perception te 'make' te 'let', ñu jëfandikoo infinitif te 'to' (I saw him leave, They made me wait). Àdaxu negation, 'not' ñoo ko def te infinitif te gerund (I decided not to go, I enjoy not working).

title: Articles Advanced: Zero Article and Generic Use / Artikoolu Avanzados: Artikoolu Cero y Uso Genérico
bridge: Ci waxoon nañu ngi déggoonu ngi ci wàlloonu yoon wi, ngir yàggale ko (baa ngi defoon 'ñoñ ñi ngi doon'), waaye ci angale, noonu lañuy wàlle: 'Dogs are loyal'. Moom kay waxe woon nañu ngi déggoonu ngi ci wàlloonu yoon wi, ngir yàggale ko (baa ngi defoon 'ñoñ ñi ngi doon'), waaye ci angale, noonu lañuy wàlle: 'Dogs are loyal'. Ci angale, noonu lañuy wàlle article ak noun bu njëkk bu am solo (baa ngi def 'I like rice'), waaye ci waxoon nañu ngi déggoonu ngi ci wàlloonu yoon wi, ngir yàggale ko (baa ngi defoon 'ñoñ ñi ngi doon')
rule: Ci angale, ñatti casamàn nekk ci 'artikoolu cero': 1) Ngir yàggale ko ci mbaa mu am solo, mu ngi ame solo (baa ngi def 'Cats are cute', 'Water is essential'). 2) Ngir noun bu njëkk bu am solo, bu ñàkk, bu spor, bu akademiya, waaye ñu ngi ame solo (baa ngi def 'I speak English', 'She plays tennis'). 3) Ngir institusiyoonu wàll, ospital, kilis, prizon, waaye ñu ngi ame solo (baa ngi def 'He goes to school' - ngir yàggale ko, waaye noonu lañuy wàlle 'to the school' ngir yàggale ko). Waxtu ngi dégg, ngir noun bu njëkk bu ame solo, bu ngi ame solo, noonu lañuy wàlle article, walla determinan, ngir yàggale ko (baa ngi def 'A dog is man's best friend' walla 'The dog is a loyal animal'). Noonu lañuy wàlle def 'Dog is loyal' ngir yàggale ko. Ci angale, noonu lañuy wàlle 'the' ngir nounu réew, waaye ñu ngi ame solo (baa ngi def 'Italy', 'Spain'), waaye noonu lañuy wàlle 'the' ngir nounu réew, ñu ngi ame solo, ngir 'republic', 'kingdom' walla 'states' (baa ngi def 'the United States')
